fusions.name: Nailed Down
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Narrowing Bars
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow fan of arrows 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stake Line
fusions.desc: Drives a line of sharpened stakes 5 tiles long into the ground for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: No Slipping Free
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.
